BEFORE YOU ASK

You might
be wondering.

What happens when I need a change?+

Tell us what you need. We’ll give you a price for that piece of work before starting. There’s no monthly retainer and no promise of unlimited changes. If something doesn’t work as agreed in the original delivery, we assess it under that agreement.

Can people book through my website?+

Yes, using a booking service you already have. A button linking to it is included. If you want its supported booking widget inside the page, that’s the €150 extra. We don’t build the booking system, manage availability or take payments ourselves.

What do you need from me?+

Your business details, approved text, logo and photographs you have permission to use. No finished text yet? Choose “Help with the words”. One page usually takes 1–2 weeks; a small site takes 2–3, once your content is ready. We confirm the schedule in your quote.

Do I own my website?+

After full payment you receive the agreed website files and a perpetual right to use, host and edit the bespoke site for your business. The domain and hosting accounts stay in your name. Third-party material keeps its own licence.

Can I edit everything myself?+

These are simple sites without an editing dashboard. We can quote for changes when you need them, or you can have another developer work with your files. If you need daily publishing or a complex content system, our offer probably isn’t the right fit.
